cells.label: fact

items.text: Raymond James's AdvisorChoice® platform offers multiple affiliation options that financial advisors can choose from, each with a unique combination of support, freedom and flexibility: Traditional Employee, Advisor Select, Independent Contractor, Bank & Credit Union, and Corporate RIA.
items.quote: Through AdvisorChoice®, you have the ability to match your professional goals to the affiliation option that's right for you... Traditional Employee... Advisor Select... Independent Contractor... Bank & Credit Union... Corporate RIA

items.text: Raymond James offers multiple affiliation options under AdvisorChoice®, and financial advisors primarily affiliate directly as either employees or independent contractors, or as employees of third-party RIAs and broker-dealers served through its RIA and Custody Services (RCS) division.
items.quote: We offer multiple affiliation options, which we refer to as AdvisorChoice®. Financial advisors primarily affiliate with us directly as either employees or independent contractors or as employees of third-party Registered Investment Advisors ("RIAs") and broker-dealers to which we provide services through our RIA and Custody Services ("RCS") division.

items.text: Employee financial advisors work in a traditional branch supported by local management and administrative staff, provide services predominantly to retail clients, and receive compensation primarily as a payout on revenues they generate plus participation in the firm's employee benefit plans.
items.quote: Employee financial advisors work in a traditional branch supported by local management and administrative staff. They provide services predominantly to retail clients. Compensation for these financial advisors primarily includes a payout on revenues they generate and such advisors also participate in the firm's employee benefit plans.

items.text: Independent contractor financial advisors are generally responsible for all of their direct costs and accordingly receive a higher payout percentage on revenues than employee financial advisors; they may affiliate directly or through an affiliated bank or credit union in the Financial Institutions Division, and with approval may conduct certain other approved business activities such as insurance, independent RIA services, and accounting/tax services.
items.quote: Our financial advisors who are independent contractors are generally responsible for all of their direct costs and, accordingly, receive a higher payout percentage on the revenues they generate than employee financial advisors... Independent contractor financial advisors may affiliate with us directly or through an affiliated bank or credit union in our Financial Institutions Division.

items.text: The AdvisorChoice spectrum spans Employee (RJA), Advisor Select, Independent Advisor (ICD), Banks and Credit Unions, IAR (Corporate RIA), and RIA & Custody Services, and the firm states the movement to 'independence' is not channel-specific.
items.quote: EMPLOYEE ADVISOR (RJA) — ADVISOR SELECT — INDEPENDENT ADVISOR (ICD) — BANKS AND CREDIT UNIONS — IAR* (CORPORATE RIA) — RIA** & CUSTODY SERVICES... The movement to "independence" is not channel-specific

items.text: As an independent contractor, an advisor can access Raymond James's full capabilities (private wealth, technology, marketing) while operating their own independent practice backed by a full-service, self-clearing NYSE-member broker/dealer.
items.quote: When you affiliate with Raymond James as an independent contractor, you can access our full capabilities at a level that's right for your business... Serve your clients and grow your independent practice... the support of a full-service, self-clearing New York Stock Exchange-member broker/dealer.

items.text: Advisor Select® is an employee affiliation option that provides established advisors the full benefits of the employee channel with the independence to create their own branches and run their branch's P&L to earn a higher rate on production.
items.quote: Advisor Select® provides established advisors the full benefits of our employee channel with the independence to create their own branches... run your branch's P&L to earn a higher rate on production. Advisor Select® is... an employee affiliation option

items.text: Through the RIA & Custody Services (RCS) division, an independent registered investment advisor (RIA) retains complete freedom and control of its business, using as much or as little of Raymond James's support as needed, with strategic, financial and administrative control free from retail conflict.
items.quote: As an independent registered investment advisor (RIA) with a committed custodian partner... Our RIA & Custody Services division gives you true strategic, financial and administrative control to grow your business your way, free from retail conflict and using as much - or as little - of our support as you need.
